note: duplicate groups union the pair itself instead of its roots, so chains break (no transitivity), caught by chainsGroup
duplicate groups keep singleton groups, caught by singletonsDropped
duplicate groups treat a hash exactly the distance away as far, caught by distanceIsInclusive
duplicate groups do not clamp the distance to 16, caught by distanceIsClamped
duplicate groups BK-tree prunes edges one bit too tight, caught by matchesBruteForceOnSeededClusters
anchor: where edge >= d - radius && edge <= d + radius
replacement: where edge > d - radius && edge <= d + radius
